title: Reduce high-risk any usage at external boundaries
tasks: Identify high-risk `any` typed inputs from external API and provider boundaries.
Replace with explicit discriminated/domain contracts where enforcement is safe.
Add regression tests for mapped domains where external payload shapes are parsed or transformed.
definition_of_done: High-risk `any` usage on external boundary contracts is reduced and documented.
Domain contracts compile under `npm run build`.
Regression coverage captures representative external payload shapes.
Release evidence records before/after risk surface reduction.
